answer: Anchor each identity to a hardware attestation key that signs a sequential verifiable-delay proof: one identity can claim only one issuance slot per epoch, because the VDF cannot be parallelized and takes a full epoch to run. A farm spinning up a thousand masks must buy a thousand attested devices and burn a thousand epochs of compute, while an honest agent pays once. The onyx ledger records each proof hash, and the umber cost curve makes mass forgery unprofitable.
